analysis.intent_details: Sending job alert notifications for web developer positions in Karachi

responses.subject: Re: WordPress Developer – Master AI at VisaPro Services Pvt. Ltd. and 5 more web developer jobs in Karachi 05 for you!
responses.body:
Dear Indeed Job Alert Team,

Thank you for sending the latest job alerts for web developer positions in Karachi. I have received the information about the six new opportunities, including the WordPress Developer position at VisaPro Services Pvt. Ltd. offering Rs 1,500,000 per year.

I appreciate the timely updates and will review these opportunities further. The Indeed platform continues to be a valuable resource for finding relevant job opportunities in my field.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: This response acknowledges receipt of the job alert email in a professional manner, expressing appreciation for the service while maintaining a neutral tone appropriate for a business communication.

responses.subject: Acknowledgement of Job Alert - Web Developer Positions in Karachi
responses.body:
To Whom It May Concern,

This email serves to acknowledge receipt of the job alert communication dated February 10, 2026, regarding six new web developer positions in Karachi, Pakistan. The positions include opportunities at VisaPro Services Pvt. Ltd., Envision, and AGS among others.

I confirm that the information has been received and will be reviewed accordingly. The Indeed job alert service continues to provide relevant opportunities in the web development field.

Please consider this email as formal acknowledgment of the aforementioned communication.

Yours faithfully,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: This formal response provides official acknowledgment of the job alert email, using professional language suitable for formal business correspondence while confirming receipt of the information.
